body: Build order is enforced manually in Taskfile (not pnpm graph): 'task build:packages' (pnpm -r --filter ./packages/* build) MUST run before 'task build:ext' (pnpm --filter chrome-ext build). 'task dev' = vite watch + extension auto-reload via WebSocket on ws://localhost:8791 (service-worker listens, calls chrome.runtime.reload()).
